procedural_matters: The panel of the International Jury was composed in accordance with RRS N1.4(b).
GER 725 was represented by John Berke.
GER 4451 did not come to the hearing, the hearing proceeded in accordance with RRS 63.1(b).
facts: An incident occured between GER 725 and GER 4451 in race 10.
There was no serious damage or injury.
GER 725 finished race 10 and sailed race 11.
After coming ashore, GER 725 rigged down the boat, took down the mast and craned the boat out onto the trailer.
After craning out the boat, GER 725 went to the Jury desk.
The protest time limit for J24 was 14:49.
conclusions: GER 725 failed to deliver the protest within the protest time limit as required byRRS 61.2(b)(1).
There was no good reason for the International Jury to extend the time.
decision: The protest is invalid, the hearing is closed under RRS 63.4(a)(1).
